svg.title: University-1652: Street → satellite: R@1 retention
svg.desc: Seed 1 only. Native editable text and geometric primitives. Seed 1 only. Full official queries and clean full gallery; tasks remain separate. Higher retention does not imply higher absolute corrupted accuracy. Full uses cached CLIP for clean queries and online CLIP for corrupted queries. Full curves include evidence-path differences as well as image corruption.
